London’s First-Ever Story-Based Immersive Art: A Mind-Bending Fusion of Art and Technology

Step into the ethereal world of imagination at the Illusionaries and experience vivid memories of a departed bard. Be enraptured by an intellectually and aesthetically stimulating audio-visual experience that defies conventional expectations.

Immerse yourself in a feast for the senses as you explore vivid imagery and emotive soundscapes, culminating in an awe-inspiring spectacle.

Venture within, where time stops, and the infinite expanse of space unfolds. Immerse yourself in a sea of elusive imagery and ethereal sensations, allowing yourself to dissolve into the very fabric of the experience.

Open Monday – Thursday: 11am to 10pm, Friday & Saturday: 11am to 11pm, Sunday: 11am to 8pm. Tickets from £27, booking advised.
